scope: Independent read-only review of new background-gimmick stock, native/source registration, light/dark artwork and decoded GIF frames; no final movie acceptance.

technical.private_exact_rgba_crop_verifiers: all8pass with explicit pending=[]; no reservation changes

stock_suitability: All eight suitable as watercolor background-gimmick stock at the registered/recommended scales. Existing warm-brown contour and paper-watercolor language is coherent with bear/red-panda references; natural rainbow has intentionally soft colored edges.

notes.helicopter: First four spin-pose cabin measurements are199x131,199x130,200x133,200x131px: small hand-redraw variation. Rotor foreshortening is intended; the stable cockpit anchor and fixed per-sheet window-based calibration avoid whole-body fitting. Pitch images rotate the cabin and therefore change its axis-aligned extent. Suitable for background stock; not a precision rigid-body flight rig.
notes.airplane: Level propeller-pose fuselage measurements233x145 and234x145px; center follows painted fuselage/cockpit rather than wing/propeller footprint. Climb/descent/bank changes are intentional and preserve identity/palette.
notes.rocket: Painted nozzle anchor excludes exhaust. Anatomical preview body height296..298px across all6states; varied flame length does not produce a body-scale change. Minor hand-redraw width variation remains.
notes.butterfly: Repaired folded-up standalone frame has complete antennae and wing margins. Anatomical reference460 for folded standalone versus169 for initial sheet yields coherent body scale in the actual flap GIF. Registered native per-sheet calibration is preserved; no per-pose silhouette fitting.
notes.ladybug: Consistent red elytra, spots, brown body and six-leg/wing-opening vocabulary. Walk/takeoff/landing are usable discrete poses with scene-dependent translation.
notes.grass: Fixed sheet scales and measured root support preserve grounding; recorded3.4056percent root-span redraw variation is minor and remains documented, not corrected with per-pose fitting.
notes.flower-bed: All6flowers and color order remain identifiable, soil-and-stone support width is stable in registered comparison. No visible matte/debris in proper composites.
notes.rainbow: One complete native arch supports three explicitly procedural variants: angular reveal, opacity fade and light sweep. These are not additional generated poses; initial invisible effect states are intentional.

verification_limits: GIF review used decoded frames/filmstrips and timing/disposal checks, not a claim of human continuous playback.
Final scene placement, frequency, interpolation/path motion, occlusion, numeric content and completed MP4 remain production-specific QA.
This review does not clear previously recorded quality findings on legacy414stockposes.
